fusions.name: Sharp Report
fusions.desc: A pinpoint report deals 9 resonating damage, up to 2.2 times that at maximum range. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Overpressure
fusions.desc: A burst of sound deals 14 resonating damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stuns each for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Range Finding
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Dry Spell
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your next strike gains 40% critical hit chance. Once every 12 seconds.
